  "decision": "YES",
  "justification": "The donation of £120 from Elaine Carter on 16 March 2026 is eligible for Gift Aid because: (1) the charity is recognised as a charity for tax purposes (per E02), (2) the donation is from an individual (per E06), (3) the donor has paid at least as much in Income Tax as the claimed Gift Aid (Elaine paid £980, the claimed Gift Aid is £30 on this donation, which is within her tax paid), (4) Elaine made a valid Gift Aid declaration covering this donation (per E05), (5) the donation is not through Payroll Giving (per E09), (6) it is not for goods or services or linked to a purchase (per E10), (7) the donor does not receive any benefit over a certain limit (per E11), (8) no shares or securities were delivered (per E12), and (9) it is not from a charity card or voucher (per E13). The donation is a direct personal payment with no linked benefit or service, and the records confirm it is separate from CAF card/voucher transactions. Thus, all conditions for Gift Aid eligibility are met.",
